    s=fr.segmentation; out=[]
    for n in s['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']<40:
            cc=[s['nodes'][c]['color'] for c in n['children']]
            out.append(('P' if cc and cc[0]=='W' else 'G', n['boundary']))
    return out
print('player+ghosts:', ents(current_frame))
print('done:', r['done'], 'lvl:', r['level_completed'])
